associations.rationale: The theorem states pairwise nonisomorphism for Specht modules indexed by distinct partitions, but it does not itself state irreducibility or the Young-symmetrizer and Hom-space argument described in the source claim.
The theorem states irreducibility of every Specht module, but it does not itself state pairwise nonisomorphism or the Young-symmetrizer and Hom-space argument described in the source claim.
The nonzero scalar-square identity for the row-column symmetrizer is an input to the irreducibility argument, not the irreducibility or nonisomorphism conclusion itself.
Simplicity of the Young-projector left ideal supports the Specht-module argument but does not itself state the source claim about the Specht modules.
